title: Implement authoritative verification execution
objective: Implement canonical control-store resolution, immutable evidence/index projections, repository admission, supervisor lifecycle, descendant containment contract, failure fences/grants and the neutral allowlist+sandbox command bridge.
test_seam: Backend fixtures must discover available candidates and independently prove protected-path enforcement plus strong descendant containment with adversarial qualification checks before launch. Process-lifecycle fixtures must prove fail-closed refusal before spawn, cancellation and descendant drainage, and restart reconciliation bound to durable backend/execution identity; missing or insufficient durable identity returns UNCERTAIN and blocks admission. Preserve critical FAIL fencing, one-shot grant consumption, protected authority and repository-wide admission ordering.
